meta.description: Position n in verified_questions.json -> source model/batch and original index. Gemini compare file omitted (duplicates batch 4). Meta AI Hard Quant batches meta_hard_p1/meta_hard_p2 appended (codes MH1/MH2). Gemini Argon 4.0 batches 8 (Reasoning, GB8) and 9 (English, GB9) and Meta AI English/Reasoning batches meta_eng_p1/p2 (ME1/ME2) and meta_rea_p1/p2 (MR1/MR2) appended; index is the item's position in the source file (dropped items leave gaps). Claude General Awareness (static GK) batches claude_ga_p1/p2/p3 appended (codes GA1/GA2/GA3); index is the question's original id in Claude's output; fact_source and ga_area record the cited source and sub-area.
